scripts.build: node scripts/build-client-installer.mjs && pnpm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts eslint.config.mjs package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts eslint.config.mjs package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html
scripts.test: node scripts/build-client-installer.mjs --check && pnpm run typecheck && sh scripts/test-client-installer.sh && sh scripts/test-client-updates.sh
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
